summaries.1: 1 Hosea to shew Gods iudgement for spirituall whoredome, taketh Gomer, 4 and hath by her Iezreel, 6 Lo-ruhamah, 8 and Lo-ammi. 10 The restauration of Iudah and Israel.
summaries.2: 1 The idolatrie of the people. 6 Gods iudgements against them. 14 His promises of reconciliation with them.
summaries.3: 1 By the expiation of an adulteresse, 4 is shewed the desolation of Israel before their restauration.
summaries.4: 1 Gods iudgements against the sinnes of the people, 6 and of the priests, 12 and against their idolatrie. 15 Iudah is exhorted to take warning by Israels calamitie.
summaries.5: 1 Gods iudgements against the Priests, the people, and the princes of Israel for their manifold sinnes, 15 vntill they repent.
summaries.6: 1 An exhortation to repentance. 4 A complaint of their vntowardnesse, and iniquitie.
summaries.7: 1 A reproofe of manifold sinnes. 11 Gods wrath against them for their hypocrisie.
summaries.8: 1.12 Destruction is threatned for their impietie, 5 and idolatrie.
summaries.9: The distresse and captiuitie of Israel, for their sinnes and idolatrie.
summaries.10: Israel is reproued and threatned for their impietie and idolatry.
summaries.11: 1 The ingratitude of Israel vnto God for his benefits. 5 His iudgement. 8 Gods mercy toward them.
summaries.12: 1 A reproose of Ephraim, Iudah, and Iacob. 3 By former fauours he exhorteth to repentance. 7 Ephraims sinnes prouoke God.
summaries.13: 1 Ephraims glory, by reason of idolatry, vanisheth. 5 Gods anger for their vnkindnes. 9 A promise of Gods mercie. 15 A iudgement for rebellion.
summaries.14: 1 An exhortation to repentance. 4 A promise of Gods blessing.
